source: Align endorsement actions, add schedule tabs, and contain policy overflow

assumptions.text: The two attached screenshots are the source of truth for the endorsement and schedule table layouts.
Action tiles use Card and Button footers; table views use Tabs, Table, Badge, Alert, Calendar, Popover, Select, and Pagination.
Endorsements and schedules are in-page tabs; pending and generated are nested schedule tabs backed by static demonstration data.
Success uses the Compass primary Badge because there is no dedicated semantic success-green token.
Wide tables scroll within their Table container while the dashboard shell remains fixed to the viewport.
